events.label: OrbitFabric Analytics baseline collection begins
events.notes: Internal observability milestone; not an explanatory external event.

events.label: OrbitFabric F´ Adapter v0.1.0 first stable release
events.notes: First stable public release of the OrbitFabric F´ Adapter, published earlier on the same day as the upstream F´ discussion event.

events.label: OrbitFabric F´ Adapter v0.1.1 release identity correction
events.notes: Same-day patch release correcting release Source Coordinate metadata while preserving the accepted v0.1.0 integration behavior.

events.label: F´ upstream discussion on deployment-resolved identity and COSMOS generation
events.notes: OrbitFabric F´ adapter evidence introduced into the upstream discussion, focusing on generated-dictionary provenance, deployment-resolved identity across native layout refactors, and explicit diagnostics for lossy COSMOS mappings.

events.label: Libre Space contribution on GPSD and PPS station clock discipline
events.notes: Strong technical community contribution by the OrbitFabric maintainer. The contribution is not about OrbitFabric and must not be treated as direct ecosystem outreach; its relevance is indirect through maintainer reputation and possible later ecosystem discovery.

events.label: Libre Space contribution on INSPIRESat-1 telemetry access and bulk frame export
events.notes: Strong technical community contribution by the OrbitFabric maintainer around SatNOGS telemetry access. It is not OrbitFabric-specific; any relation to OrbitFabric traffic is indirect through reputation and possible ecosystem discovery, not direct promotion.

events.label: Libre Space PHASMA discussion on XTCE and C serializer contract alignment
events.notes: Technical discussion around PHASMA as an interoperability case, highlighting the risk of packet-contract drift when XTCE layouts and C serializers evolve as separate representations.

events.label: NASA EdsLib upstream issue on unmatched-derived position-zero dispatch semantics
events.notes: Evidence-led semantics clarification filed after the EDS-cFS P3 characterization showed that an undefined Function Code can fall through an unmatched derived-type lookup to dispatch position zero. The report includes exact frozen cFS/cFE/EdsLib baselines, FC 0 and FC 1 positive controls, the FC 127 negative probe, exact packet bytes, a causal pressure test, a genuinely non-derived NASA SAMPLE_APP control, pre-Draco historical context, and a curated evidence bundle. It deliberately does not classify the behavior as a bug pending maintainer clarification.

events.label: OpenC3 F Prime upstream issue on qualified enum and struct array parsing
events.notes: Evidence-led upstream issue filed after the R1 F Prime to OpenC3 integration exposed a repeatable KeyError when the plugin parser consumes arrays whose elementType is a qualified enum or struct. The report includes native F Prime provenance, discriminating controls, minimal standalone reproducers, exact parser boundary, and retained public CI evidence. OrbitFabric is provenance for the integration exercise, not the requested behavior.

events.label: NASA cFS contribution on residual OSAL CI message-queue limits
events.notes: Technical upstream contribution tracing the residual cFS native test failure to POSIX message-queue limits already handled by OSAL standalone CI, with a concrete workflow-level sysctl alignment proposal. The contribution itself is not an OrbitFabric change; its relevance is through cFS integration expertise and the EDS-cFS ecosystem.

events.label: F Prime XTCE upstream PR for installed-package validation and CI
events.notes: Upstream code contribution adds installed-package XTCE schema lookup, post-generation XSD validation, regression coverage and Python 3.8/3.11 CI. The validated candidate passed 14/14 tests on each supported Python endpoint. The contribution is upstream F Prime tooling work rather than an OrbitFabric product change.

events.label: OpenOBSW S9 runtime evidence on missing TC(9,128) route
events.notes: Bounded OpenSVF/OpenOBSW runtime experiment showed TC(9,128) reaching the real OpenOBSW dispatcher with no route, while TC(17,1) passed as a positive control. The evidence separated simulator-side OBT from real-binary OBT effects and led to maintainer confirmation that S9 belongs in the real OpenOBSW scope, with S11/S12/S19 split for separate evaluation.

events.label: F Prime bare-metal upstream PR for TlmLinearChan allocator-safe deinit
events.notes: Upstream code contribution moves allocator-dependent TlmLinearChan cleanup from the C++ destructor into the explicit F Prime deinit lifecycle, removes the destruction-order workaround, and adds a tracking-allocator regression proving one deallocation during deinit and none during component destruction. Real local validation passed the complete TlmLinearChan 5/5 suite and the broader relevant 3/3 regression set.

events.label: NASA cFS incorporates FAROTECH OSAL message-queue CI proposal
events.notes: NASA merged cFS PR

events.label: OpenOBSW incorporates orbital-aliasing evidence into B-dot fix and validation handoff
events.notes: OpenOBSW merged PR

events.label: F Prime Python Model discussion on semantic-model navigation documentation
events.notes: Evidence-based contribution from the public OrbitFabric F Prime semantic-reconciliation example identifies concrete model-navigation friction around ast_id_map versus annotated_ast_id_map, component semantic maps, source provenance and telemetry packet membership, and offers a focused documentation PR if maintainers consider the direction useful.

events.label: LinkedIn post on R1 one mission contract across F Prime and OpenC3 COSMOS
events.notes: Public post presenting the R1 Engineering Story as one canonical mission-level semantic root driving independently owned F Prime and OpenC3 COSMOS paths through a live flight-ground verification loop. Retained as outreach context that may correlate with subsequent visits to the Reference Mission and OrbitFabric ecosystem.
